about_the_game:
COUNTY HOSPITAL: CAUTERY is a 4-player cooperative sci-fi horror experiment with a twist and flamethrowers. Complete a multi-stage mission to eradicate a biological outbreak, but beware: success triggers a hidden protocol, turning one of you into an specimen that hunts the rest.

▶ SINGLEPLAYER  or 4-PLAYER CO-OP & PVP 

Inmerse in a solo campaing mode or work as a team using flamethrowers to complete 8 interconnected objectives: photograph organisms, restore power, retrieve key items, activate systems, and cleanse the facility.

▶ A FULL CAMPAIGN IN ONE MISSION

A dense, 1-2 hour layered operation inside the infected County Hospital. Substantial cooperative raid with progression, puzzles, and a climactic boss fight.

▶ THE TRAITOR PROTOCOL

After the final boss falls, the real experiment begins. One random player is transformed into a giant spider with unique abilities, turning the game into a tense PvP hunt. 

•  4-Player Online Co-Op  – Steam invites ON GAME

• Objective-Based Gameplay – 8-stage mission

• Asymmetric PvP Finale – The hunted becomes the hunter in a genre shift.

• Specimen Rotation – Players can become the monster multiple times per match via AI infection.

• Strategic Resource Management – Recharge suits at the mobile station; conserve fuel,

• Original Soundtrack & SFX – Custom-made audio and music for full immersion.

Another INDIE fine release from LFR Games

Support Real Indies!

content_descriptors.notes: you will use a flamethrower to burn the decapitated semi-naked bodies

short_description: County Hospital Cautery is a 4-player online co-op and single-player sci-fi horror game. Experiments in a secret laboratory hidden behind an abandoned hospital have gone too far, you and your team must use all the equipment to eliminate the threat before a worse one awakens. Get your flametrhower!
